title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE ON THE STAIRS, THEN GLUTES AND HINGE WORK. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. WEDNESDAY. WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE STAIR BALANCE, THEN WAKE THOSE DESK GLUTES. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THE KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR DONE. BACK HONEST. GLUTES AWAKE. NOW GET BACK TO THAT DESK AND EARN YOUR KEEP.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: USE A LOW STAIR. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON THE RAIL IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. DRIVE THROUGH THE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT THE HIPS. HOLD A BEAT AT THE TOP. RIBS DOWN. DO NOT ARCH THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE AND LIFT. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR POSTERIOR WORK. DO NOT THRUST LIKE A DRUNK AT A DISCO.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. FEEL THE BACK LEG AND GLUTE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. FEEL THE GLUTE. THIS IS YOUR POSTERIOR WORK. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A WET TENT.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. BREATHE. CONTROL BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR CORE WORK UNDER THE POSTERIOR LOAD. DO NOT FLOP LIKE A PANICKED BEETLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
